{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Ensure `converted` is int64 (it already is, per earlier check)
df['converted'] = df['converted'].astype(int)

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rate_by_segment = df.groupby('customer_segment', observed=True)['converted'].mean() * 100

# Print the full series to ensure all values are output
print("Conversion rates by segment (in percent):")
print(conversion_rate_by_segment)

# Extract the segment with highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rate_by_segment.index[0]

# Print the final answer
print(f"The customer_segment with the highest conversion rate is '{highest_segment}'.")"}
